title: Violation
description: GT-511 / EAG-02. One canonical normalized violation every enforcer adapter (dependency-cruiser, Deptrac, import-linter, …) and the OSS/native normalizers map into. `fingerprint` is computed WITHOUT `message` and over a normalized path so cosmetic wording never churns it and defeats freezing (GT-517). Mirrors packages/core-domain/src/evaluation/violation.ts.

ruleId.description: Rule that was violated (e.g. HXA-01, no-circular).

tool.description: Enforcer tool that produced it (e.g. dependency-cruiser, deptrac).

file.description: Repo-relative path of the offending file.

message.description: Human-readable message. NOT part of the fingerprint.

adrRef.description: ADR this rule traces to (e.g. ADR-0002).

fingerprint.description: Stable identity — normalized path + rule + tool + coords, message EXCLUDED (16-hex-char digest).

frozen.description: A frozen (baselined/waived) violation does not block (GT-517).
